how_to_apply: Download the application form provided in the official notification PDF.
Fill in all the required details in the prescribed format.
Attach a passport-size photograph and relevant educational, professional, and research documents.
Send the completed application through e-mail to Prof. Bhoj K. Acharya (PI), Department of Zoology, Sikkim University, Tadong, Gangtok at [email protected].
Ensure the application must reach the project PI by email within 21 days of publication of this advertisement.

content_sections.heading: About SU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Sikkim University is a central university established by an Act of Parliament of India in 2007 and accredited by NAAC in 2015, located at 6th Mile, Samdur, Tadong-737102, Gangtok, Sikkim. The collaborative research project is executed jointly by Sikkim University (SU) and Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology and the Environment (ATREE). The selected candidate will work under the supervision of Prof. Bhoj K. Acharya, Principal Investigator (PI) in the Department of Zoology at Sikkim University.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a First class Masters Degree in Life Sciences/ Environmental Science/Geography/ Forestry or allied disciplines with NET to be considered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Non-NET candidates can apply and will be considered as Junior Project Fellow (JPF). Working knowledge of RS-GIS, ecological modelling, R, etc., and experience of working on biodiversity in mountain environment are also mentioned.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) receives a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- + HRA 9% per month. Fellowship for JPF will be as per the norms of Ministry of Environment and Forests, Govt. of India. The duration is initially for one year but extendable up to the termination of project whichever is earlier, subject to annual performance review. The selected candidates are expected to join immediately. Project Fellow will be encouraged to enrol for higher degrees/qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through e-mail and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview at Gangtok. The selected candidates are expected to join immediately.
